studio_binding_proposal.canonical_blob_tier: ArtifactStore (UUID-addressed, manifest per file, atomic write, hash-verified, GC). Loom blobs (<root>/data/workspaces/<ws>/assets/<tier>/<hash>) are the non-canonical second tier and become a migration target: new Studio/CKC bytes never go there.
studio_binding_proposal.why: ArtifactStore already has the invariants the spec demands (manifest = PRIM-ArtifactManifest, write-once, refuses content_hash != sha256(payload), GC, layers L1-L4, retention TTL); Loom blobs have no manifest, no verification on read, no GC, and a row->blob ordering with no compensation. Choosing Loom would mean rebuilding all of that; choosing ArtifactStore means only porting a READ path (done) and a streaming WRITE path (done).

read_path_contract.manifest_identity: PRIM-ArtifactManifest = artifact://.handshake/artifacts/<layer>/<uuid>/artifact.json; the placed-asset link's artifact_manifest_id is that ref (or the (layer, uuid) pair)
read_path_contract.resolve_bytes: GET /atelier/media-assets/{asset_id}/bytes -> 200 bytes with Content-Type (catalog MIME), Content-Length, ETag "sha256-<hex>", Cache-Control private,immutable, x-hsk-artifact-ref, x-hsk-content-sha256; 404 unknown asset or missing payload; 400 non-native artifact_ref; 500 any integrity mismatch (row vs manifest, manifest vs payload). Store-level equivalent: AtelierStore::read_media_asset_bytes. The link's resolved_content_hash is x-hsk-content-sha256; link state: resolved when it equals the stored resolved_content_hash, modified when it differs, missing on 404-unknown, unresolved before first call. unauthorized cannot be produced yet: no ResourceBroker in the base (WP-KERNEL-006/007); until then the route is actor-attributed (x-hsk-actor-id) but not authorization-enforced and the spec should say so explicitly instead of implying the state exists.
read_path_contract.streaming: Read is currently buffered (whole payload in memory once, hash-verified before the first byte is sent, so a client never receives partial bytes on integrity failure). Proposed follow-up: HTTP Range + streamed body with the hash verified by a pre-pass per artifact and cached, so video seeking works; the buffered route stays the fail-closed default for images. Write IS streaming: POST /atelier/media-assets streams the raw body into the ArtifactStore with sha256+size computed on the fly and a hard ceiling.

studio_binding_proposal.crash_consistency_rule: Order is blob -> verify -> catalog row (the Atelier pattern), never row -> blob (the Loom pattern). If the row write fails or dedups, the writer removes the blob it just wrote (compensation); a crash between blob rename and row commit leaves an unreferenced, hash-addressed artifact that is never served (serving starts from a row) and is swept by artifact GC. A catalog row whose blob is missing is a 404 on read and is reported by filesystem_health; it is never auto-deleted. Rows and their EventLedger event must commit in one SurrealDB transaction (the stage_artifacts.rs BEGIN/COMMIT pattern); the reference branch's post-commit event writes (MT-056 F10) must not be ported as-is.
studio_binding_proposal.size_limits_and_eviction: Ingest ceiling HANDSHAKE_MEDIA_INGEST_MAX_BYTES (default 4 GiB) enforced while streaming; the JSON/base64 Loom import is bounded by Axum's 2 MiB body limit plus the same decoded cap and is not a bulk path. Eviction today covers only L3 TTL artifacts and excludes media originals (retention_class atelier.media.original.retained); Studio assets ingested through this route are L1 originals and are therefore never evicted automatically. Proposed: derived previews/proxies for Studio go to L3 with TTL; originals stay pinned; a Studio document's linked originals count as referenced for any future GC of unreferenced L1 payloads.
studio_binding_proposal.viewport: CKC's Atelier panel IS Studio's asset viewport: Studio opens it as the CKC module in the module rail (or a workbench pane) with a target ref (atelier://media/<asset_id>, atelier://collection/<id>, atelier://character/<id>) and gets back placed-asset picks through the typed drag payload / asset.place command. What it shows: character-scoped albums, media grid with real bytes via the byte route, tags/notes/ratings, Posekit/OpenPose, intake batches, search. Models drive it through the 128 stable atelier-ckc-* AccessKit ids (Argus list_widgets/click_widget/set_value/screenshot); MT-065 ports them verbatim and the report lists them.
spec_should_say: STU-ASSET-025 close: the artifact tier is storage::artifacts (ArtifactStore): UUID-addressed under <workspace>/.handshake/artifacts/<layer>/<uuid>/{payload,artifact.json}; manifest = PRIM-ArtifactManifest; write-once, hash-verified on write and read; GC; layers L1-L4; API = write_file_artifact / write_file_artifact_streaming / read_file_artifact / read_artifact_manifest / remove_file_artifact plus HTTP GET /atelier/media-assets/{id}/bytes and POST /atelier/media-assets; transactional relationship: blob before row, compensation on row failure, row+event in one SurrealDB transaction.
STU-ASSET-004: name Loom blobs as the existing violation and require consolidation onto the ArtifactStore (migration WP), not a retroactive ban.
STU-ASSET-005: artifact_manifest_id is the ArtifactStore manifest ref; resolved_content_hash is bare lowercase sha256 hex (the x-hsk-content-sha256 header).
STU-ASSET-007: state that `unauthorized` is producible only once WP-KERNEL-006/007 ship ResourceBroker; until then resolution is attributed, not authorized, and MUST NOT be reported as `missing`.
STU-ASSET-008: bulk binary MUST ingest through the streaming route with the ceiling; base64/JSON ingest is forbidden for Studio assets.

STU-ASSET-012..014: export-back = POST /atelier/media-assets (streamed) + catalog row + derivation edge; the edge record does not exist yet in CKC (no atelier derivation table) and MUST be added before export-back is claimed.
